name: UAE National Cybersecurity Strategy (2025–2031)
owner: United Arab Emirates Government Portal (u.ae) & UAE Cyber Security Council
description: UAE National Cybersecurity Strategy 2025–2031 (approved by UAE Cabinet January 2025). National cybersecurity strategy of the United Arab Emirates issued by the UAE Cyber Security Council (CSC) and the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by United Arab Emirates Government Portal (u.ae) & UAE Cyber Security Council (u.ae) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for United Arab Emirates Government Portal (u.ae) & UAE Cyber Security Council (u.ae).
